Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to start a small pilot with a sandbox tenant for the search-assist workflow. Before we kick off, a couple quick questions: 

- Do we get API keys per-project or per-organization?
- Can we create multiple projects under the same tenant (one for staging, one for pilot)?
- What's the recommended role model for devs vs analysts (we need token restrictions)?
- Any special steps needed for our HIPAA-scope environment (we manage ePHI in a separate VPC)?

Hi Sophie — great to hear you're ready to pilot. Looping in Monica (CS) and Karthik (implementation) so we can map out a short mutual action plan. High-level answers below; we will follow up with a step-by-step checklist and invites.

- API keys: We provision a sandbox tenant with a pair of API keys (read/write) scoped to that tenant. You can then create multiple projects inside the tenant; keys are tenant-scoped but we recommend creating project-level service accounts if you want stronger isolation.
- Multiple projects: Yes — tenants support multiple projects (staging/pilot/prod). Projects are primarily namespace and billing constructs.
- Roles: Typical setup: Owner (ops), Admin (provisioning), Developer (devs, no billing change), Analyst (read-only tokens for embeddings/queries). We will send a role mapping CSV.
- HIPAA: For HIPAA-scoped workloads we recommend using Redwood Private or Dedicated with VPC peering. For the pilot you can use hosted sandbox with strict logging retention and field-level redaction, but production ePHI should be routed to Private.

Proposed next steps (I'll own coordination):
1) Karthik to share a tenant setup checklist + required info (domain, SSO, initial user list).
2) Monica to schedule a 30-min kickoff with Lumina IT this week for access provisioning.
3) We provision sandbox tenant and send API keys + project invite.

When would Sophie & Carlos be available for a short call? We're flexible Thu/Fri mornings PST.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi all — attaching the tenant-setup-checklist (PDF) and a CSV template for roles. Summary of the technical steps we need from Lumina IT: 

1) Tenant basic info: desired tenant name, admin email, billing contact.
2) Domain verification (if you want SSO) or SAML metadata for SSO connection.
3) Initial user list (email, role: Owner/Admin/Developer/Analyst).
4) Indicate whether the pilot will use hosted sandbox or Dedicated trial (you mentioned ePHI; if you want us to use a dedicated trial region, say so).

Notes on API keys and restrictions: 
- We issue a pair of keys for the tenant (primary + rotate-ready).
- Developers can be given project-level service accounts; those tokens can be limited to specific endpoints (e.g., embeddings-only).
- Token rotation: keys support one-click rotation via the Console API.

I'll provision the sandbox as soon as we have the tenant info. If you prefer, I can provision an initial tenant with placeholder admin (redwood+lumina-sandbox@redwood.ai) and then hand over.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Implementation Lead
Redwood Inference
